pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī aññatarissā itthiyā kulūpikā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.3: atha kho sā itthi taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.4: hand' ayye imaṃ saṃghāṇiṃ amukāya nāma itthiyā dehīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.6: sac' āhaṃ pattena ādāya gacchāmi vissaro me bhavissatīti paṭimuñcitvā agamāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo saṃghāṇiṃ dhāressanti, seyyathāpi gihikāmabhoginiyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.10: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.11: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā x . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī saṃghāṇiṃ dhāressatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.13: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī saṃghāṇiṃ dhāresīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.19.1: yā pana bhikkhunī saṃghāṇiṃ dhāreyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
